notes: 2002 three-storey infill in peach stucco with cream trim at the Post corner, in the same wall as the shop block beside it. Two three-sided bays on the upper storeys, a sash window and small round windows beneath; ground has a dark panelled door, a service panel and a grid-paned window. The year-built field is the only thing saying this is newer than its neighbours. Applied: tan stucco, brown-framed dark-green arched door, big multi-pane ground window, angled bays with light frames. Porthole windows and quoins have no key and are skipped; storey count kept at the data (spec 3). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Tan stucco tint, rectangular dark wood door with a grille, dark-framed glass-block window, deeper bays, plain cap moulding, two portholes via hand.py. Lifted/converted once to #f8ecd4.
